purpose: Offline NASA global Mars topography (MGS MOLA MEGDR 16ppd -> 8ppd 2880x1440), MOLA Color Shaded Relief, and Viking MDIM 2.1 Colorized Global Mosaic (zoom 3) for 3D Mars terrain globe & spherical EVA

sources.name: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR 16ppd & 4ppd Global Topography (MEGT90N000EB.IMG / MEGT90N000CB.IMG)
sources.note: Real global Mars elevation (-8,135 m to +21,159 m above IAU2000 GMM3 areoid, 0.0625 deg source / 2880x1440 lossless 16-bit PNG in data/demo/mars-mola-dem.png) used for 3D globe radial displacement, tangent normal map, and planetary EVA surface.

sources.name: NASA / USGS Mars Viking MDIM 2.1 Colorized Global Mosaic (232 m)
sources.note: Real planetary global Mars surface albedo mosaic from Mars Trek WMTS zoom 3 tiles (16x8 = 128 tiles), stitched offline into 2880x1440 data/demo/mars-viking-global.jpg.

sources.name: NASA MGS MOLA Color Shaded Relief Merge (463 m)
sources.note: Real global Mars MOLA color shaded-relief mosaic from Mars Trek WMTS zoom 3 tiles (16x8 = 128 tiles), stitched offline into 2048x1024 data/demo/mars-mola-shaded.jpg.
